### 3.5. Scanning Electron Microscopy

[Figure 6](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f006) shows the SEM–EDS micrographs of the bronze exposed to acid rain at different inhibitor concentrations after 24 h. [Figure 6](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f006)a shows the micrograph at 0 ppm, where the dissolution of the passive copper oxide layer in acid rain is observed. In bronze alloys, Cu and Zn ions are selectively dissolved due to the decuprification and dezincification processes of bronze. On the contrary, Sn tends to form the patina layer (insoluble in some media) that stabilizes it through passivation [[32](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B32-coatings-14-01152)]. In this study, the PC results showed the dissolution of the bronze without forming a stable passive layer. E. Bernardi et al. report an average surface depth loss of ~13 µm, with an increase in roughness, as seen in [Figure 6](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f006)a [[33](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B33-coatings-14-01152)]. The EDS analysis showed mainly the presence of copper (62%), followed by zinc (3%) and tin (1.6%), but very little oxygen content (3.8%), probably in the form of SnO 2.

**Figure 6.** SEM–EDS images of the bronze surface obtained after electrochemical tests in acid rain solution with (**a**) 0 ppm, (**b**) 10 ppm, (**c**) 25 ppm, (**d**) 50 ppm, and (**e**) 100 ppm.

The patina formation on the bronze surface is observed by introducing 10 ppm of the inhibitor ([Figure 6](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f006)b) into the acid rain medium. However, this passive layer does not achieve surface homogeneity, leaving areas exposed to the medium where pitting corrosion is observed. Cubic crystals are observed in the morphology of corrosion products due to cuprous oxide [[34](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B34-coatings-14-01152)]. The EDS analysis mainly shows copper (51.6%), chloride (15%), zinc (2.5%), and oxygen (2.8%), indicating a low formation of cuprite (Cu 2 O) and the formation of CuCl and copper-zinc (Cu 3 Zn) [[32](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B32-coatings-14-01152)]. The low presence of SnO 2 is also observed.

At an inhibitor concentration of 25 ppm (see [Figure 6](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f006)c), a more significant amount of corrosion products stabilized by the inhibitor is observed on the surface, but with a non-homogeneous distribution. This patina formation enhances the efficiency of inhibiting corrosion. The morphology surface shows nanocrystals in certain regions corresponding to cassiterite (SnO 2) and/or hydroxide, which was corroborated by Raman spectroscopy [[33](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B33-coatings-14-01152)]. The corrosion layer inhomogeneity could be related to the bronze microstructure [[35](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B35-coatings-14-01152)]; dendrites are observed where areas preferably with tin products are in high relief, and oxides containing Cu are in low relief. The EDS analysis mainly shows zinc (20%), copper (11.8%), chloride (11.8%), and oxygen (5%). In the SEM–EDS image, copper oxide is found in low relief; however, according to the W % of the elements, CuCl is mainly found. Dendrite crystals in high relief correspond to the presence of SnO 2, which is observed accompanied by zinc crystals, probably as a product of the dezincification processes of bronze [[32](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B32-coatings-14-01152)]. Additionally, lead oxide is also observed.

The 50-ppm micrograph ([Figure 6](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f006)d) shows a patina layer formed on the bronze surface in a more homogeneous and granular form, stabilizing by inhibitor. Furthermore, the surface morphology maintains the microstructure relationship at the metal–patina interface. The EDS analysis of the oxide layer shows mainly copper (44%), 15% chlorine, and 1.2% sulfur, indicating the formation of CuCl and CuS in low relief and little cuprite. In high relief, it is mainly found by SnO 2, included with by Sn-Zn. Therefore, the high copper content is due to the formation of an imidazoline complex on the surface of the bronze. At a concentration of 100 ppm, a thin layer of patina, also composed of Cu 2 0, CuCl, CuS, and SnO 2, is formed ([Figure 6](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f006)e). However, areas with microcracks are observed due to the leaching of the oxide layer formed that is not stabilized by the inhibitor. In certain areas, the inhibitor does not adhere to the metal surface due to the adsorption-desorption by intermolecular interactions due to the high concentration of the inhibitor, as observed in electrochemical impedance and potentiodynamic polarization. These results agree with the highest inhibition efficiency found at 50 ppm, indicating that the inhibitor stabilizes the protective oxide layer at this concentration, providing adequate protection of bronze against acid rain.

### 3.6. XRD and Raman Spectroscopy Analysis

XRD analyzed the oxides formed on the surface of the bronze after exposure to acid rain (24 h). [Figure 7](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f007) shows the diffractograms of the bronze before and after its exposure to acid rain with 0 and 50 ppm of the inhibitor. In the diffractogram of the bronze, the composition of the bronze described in [Table 1](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#table_body_display_coatings-14-01152-t001) is observed, composed mainly of Cu (90%) and Sn (10%). The peaks of the Cu at 43° and 50.4° of 2θ, and δ-Cu-Sn phase diffraction patterns are shown at 2θ: 43°, 49°, 62° and 72° [[36](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B36-coatings-14-01152)]. The natural mechanism of bronze corrosion is the formation of patina; this layer is mainly formed by cuprite (Cu 2 O) and cassiterite (SnO 2) and protects the bronze from corrosion [[36](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B36-coatings-14-01152)]. In the X-ray diffraction spectrum of bronze at 0 ppm, the formation of the cuprite (Cu 2 O) phase is mainly presented. Cuprite is a high-symmetry cubic crystal [[37](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B37-coatings-14-01152)], and its diffraction patterns are observed at 2 Theta (°): 36.5°, 42°, 60°, and 72° [[38](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B38-coatings-14-01152)]. Cuprite is insoluble in water and slightly soluble in acid, so its crystal deposition is not well observed in SEM–EDS. However, the SnO 2 phase is slightly detected on the bronze surface in the DRX analysis by the copper diffusion through the SnO 2 film [[39](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B39-coatings-14-01152)]. The diffraction pattern in the inhibitor presence at 50 ppm shows diffraction peaks at 10 2θ, forming a cuprous complex—presumably, copper fatty imidazoline, which aligns with the SEM-EDS analysis result. Imidazole derivatives have been reported to form a Cu (Imi)2 complex on the surface of copper and its alloys [[28](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B28-coatings-14-01152),[39](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B39-coatings-14-01152)]. In this study, the Cu–fatty imidazoline complex formation is probably induced by the presence of Cu(I) due to the oxidation to Cu++, where vacant cations (VCu+) are formed on the oxide surface, Cu+ cations migrate from the metal/oxide interface to the oxide surface [[40](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B40-coatings-14-01152)]. In the same diffractogram, XRD has a limited detection of nantokite CuCl, which SEM–EDS observes well. Covellite CuS, antlerite Cu 3 SO 4(OH)4, and very slight SnO 2 are also observed [[37](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B37-coatings-14-01152)].

**Figure 7.** Diffractograms of the bronze and the patina formed on the bronze surface at 0 and 50 ppm after exposure to acid rain.

The oxides formed on the bronze surface after exposure to acid rain at different inhibitor concentrations were analyzed by Raman spectroscopy ([Figure 8](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f008)). The Raman spectrum at a concentration of 0 ppm shows mainly the Cu lattice band at 100 cm−1 and two broad bands at 533 and 619 cm−1, corresponding to the passive layer on pure copper [[37](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B37-coatings-14-01152)]. Cuprite (Cu 2 O) formation is usually observed in acid rain, presenting a strong band at 218 cm−1 [[33](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B33-coatings-14-01152),[41](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B41-coatings-14-01152)]. However, cuprite is not observed in Raman due to the bronze dissolution in the medium at 0 ppm, as seen in the optical micrograph in [Figure 8](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f008)a and the PC result. On the contrary, cuprite crystals were more sensitive to detection by XRD analysis after exposure to acid rain on bronze. The growth of rose-type crystals is observed in optical micrographs of bronze exposed to acid rain using 10 to 50 ppm of inhibitor ([Figure 8](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f008)b–d), composed of a heterogeneous layer of cuprite/tenorite called a “noble patina”, which is not particular to an environment but is frequently found in archaeological bronzes as a product of atmospheric oxidation [[41](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B41-coatings-14-01152),[42](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B42-coatings-14-01152)]. A remarkable similarity can be observed in the Raman spectra related to these micrographs ([Figure 8](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f008)b–e), which showed the presence of tenorite (CuO) oxidation product of Cu 2 O in the air [[31](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B31-coatings-14-01152)]. A strong band for CuO is observed at 296 cm−1, other weak vibrational modes at 345 cm−1 and 630 cm−1, and a feeble band in the spectral range 1110–1232 cm−1 [[41](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B41-coatings-14-01152),[42](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B42-coatings-14-01152),[43](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B43-coatings-14-01152)]. Cuprite is slightly observed in the 10–50 ppm spectrum. Tenorite is characterized by the brown patina, observed mainly in the micrograph and the spectrum at 100 ppm. The formation of covellite (CuS) is shown in the 10–100 ppm spectra in the vibrational mode at 468 cm−1, which is visually observed as dark indigo blue in the 50-ppm micrograph ([Figure 8](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f008)d) [[41](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B41-coatings-14-01152),[42](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B42-coatings-14-01152)].

**Figure 8.** Optical micrographs at 20× and their Raman spectra of the patina formed on the surface of the bronze exposed to acid rain at different inhibitor concentrations. C 1: Cuprite (Cu 2 O), T: Tenorite (CuO), C 2: Covellite (CuS), C 3: Casiterita nano-crystals of SnOx(OH)y), A: Antlerite (Cu 3 SO 4(OH)4), nantokite (CuCl),and R: Rouaite (Cu 2(NO 3)(OH)3).

The XRD analysis showed the presence of copper sulfate and nantokite CuCl. Studies report the stability of specific copper hydroxy sulfate minerals under different pH conditions. Brochantite Cu 4(OH)6 SO 4 is not stable at acid rain pH (<4), but antlerite (Cu 3(OH)4 SO 4) was observed by XRD [[37](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B37-coatings-14-01152)]. In the Raman spectra, the symmetric stretching mode of SO 4 2− at 972 cm−1 is slightly observed [[41](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B41-coatings-14-01152),[42](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B42-coatings-14-01152),[43](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B43-coatings-14-01152)]. Nantokite CuCl is not observed in Raman spectra because it exhibits thermal degradation in Raman detection (785 nm laser), which makes its measurement difficult [[43](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B43-coatings-14-01152)]. The simultaneous presence of green, pink, and mixed areas is observed in the 25–50 ppm micrographs ([Figure 8](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f008)b–d). The greenish patina is due to the nantokite CuCl, the antlerite Cu 3(OH)4 SO 4, and the probable rouaite (Cu 2(NO 3) (slight band at 1035 cm−1) (OH)3) [[38](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B38-coatings-14-01152),[39](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B39-coatings-14-01152)]. Studies report the relationship between size and spectral changes in nanocrystalline SnO 2 [[23](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B23-coatings-14-01152)]. Reducing the particle size shifts the Raman band, resulting in a single broadband at ~580 cm−1. Sharygin and Vovk [[44](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B44-coatings-14-01152)] suggest that the band at ~580 cm−1 is not only due to surface modes but also to tin oxyhydroxide. Then, the SnO 2 nanocrystals signal appears at 576 cm−1 in the Raman spectra, probably corresponding to tin oxide and/or hydroxide nanocrystals [[33](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B33-coatings-14-01152),[44](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B44-coatings-14-01152),[45](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B45-coatings-14-01152)]. Finally, the bands of the organic inhibitor appear mainly in the 10–50 ppm spectra. The symmetric C–H stretching bands of the alkyl chains of the surfactant-type inhibitor are slightly observed at 2927 cm−1, at 1614 cm−1, the C=C stretching band of alky chain unsaturation, and the methylene band of the alkyl chains at 1452 cm−1.

### 3.7. Surface Wettability

In [Figure 9](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f009), the contact angle of the bronze surface is shown at 0 ppm and 50 ppm of inhibitor after 24 h of exposure to acid rain. The contact angle recorded for the specimen at 0 ppm concentration was 36° ± 2, while for the 50-ppm concentration the contact angle increased significantly to 116° ± 1. This increase in the contact angle confirms the surface hydrophobicity by forming a Cu (Imi)2 complex that stabilizes the corrosion products using 50 ppm of the inhibitor. The surfactant-type inhibitor is adsorbed on the bronze surface through non-shared electron pairs of a heteroatom (N), and the unsaturation of the alkyl chain by the interaction between the π electrons and the d orbitals of the metal forming a hydrophobic layer that prevents the penetration of the medium into the surface [[22](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B22-coatings-14-01152)]. A fatty imidazoline complex with copper ions Cu+ is subsequently formed during the formation of cuprite. This result may have significant implications for the industry, where the durability and resistance of bronze are crucial for the maintenance and longevity of structures and components.

### 3.8. Adsorption Isotherm

The adsorption mechanism of the protective layer on the bronze surface was investigated to determine whether it involves physisorption or chemisorption. The adsorption isotherm model was obtained by fitting the corrosion inhibition measurements and the degree of inhibitor surface coverage (θ) into the various adsorption isotherms models (Langmuir, Tempkin, and Frendlich); the model that best fit the experimental data was the Freundlich model, with a correlation coefficient of R 2 = 0.99 ([Figure 10](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#fig_body_display_coatings-14-01152-f010)). This model suggests that the adsorption process is heterogeneous, with varying affinities of binding sites on the metal surface for the inhibitor molecules [[22](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B22-coatings-14-01152)]. The inhibitor adsorption forms an insoluble complex stabilizing the oxide layer, acting as a protective barrier against the corrosive medium.

**Figure 10.** Freundlich adsorption Isotherm of fatty imidazolines on the bronze surface.

The Freundlich adsorption isotherm expressed in linear form as [[46](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B46-coatings-14-01152)]:

$$
l o g ⁡ q_{e} = \left(l o g K\right)_{f} + \frac{1}{n} \left(l o g C\right)_{e}
$$

(2)

where:

*   q e is the amount of inhibitor adsorbed per unit mass of the adsorbent (mg/g or mmol/g).

*   C e is the equilibrium concentration of the inhibitor in the solution (mg/L or mmol/L).

*   K f is the Freundlich constant related to the adsorption capacity.

*   1/n is the Freundlich exponent that indicates the intensity of adsorption.

In this form, the plot of log q e versus log C e yields a straight line, where the slope corresponds to 1/n, and the intercept gives log K f. A slope 1/n less than 1 indicates favorable adsorption on the surface, which aligns with the findings of this study.

The nature of the adsorption mechanism is closely linked to the value of the standard free energy of adsorption (ΔGads). According to established criteria, if ΔGads is equal to or greater than −20 kJ/mol, the process is attributed to physisorption, indicating an electrostatic interaction between the organic molecules of the inhibitor and the metal surface. Conversely, if ΔGads is significantly more negative, around or below −40 kJ/mol, it would suggest chemisorption, characterized by the formation of covalent bonds between the inhibitor molecules and the metal surface. The ΔGads presented in Equation (3) was used to investigate the feasibility and nature of the adsorption [[47](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-6412/14/9/1152#B47-coatings-14-01152)].

ΔGads = RT ln(55:5 K ads)

(3)

K ads is the adsorption equilibrium constant obtained from the isotherm, and 55.5 is the molar concentration of water in the solution. In this study, the experimental ΔGads value was −3.25 kJ/mol, indicating spontaneous adsorption onto the metal surface by the physisorption process. Here, charged ions (Cl−, NO 3−, SO 4−) adsorbed onto the bronze surface could easily interact with the organic complex adsorbed through electrostatic interactions.

## 4. Conclusions

This study synthesized a corrosion inhibitor derived from the oil in rice bran (waste from polished white rice) as a green surfactant-type corrosion inhibitor to protect SAE-62 bronze in a simulated acid rain solution.

The electrochemical evaluation determined an efficiency of inhibiting corrosion by 90% at an inhibitor concentration of 50 ppm. Fatty imidazolines behaved as a mixed-type inhibitor. The inhibition efficiency is due to the formation of the protective film on the bronze surface of the copper–fatty imidazoline complex, which was observed by XRD and Raman spectroscopy. The fatty imidazoline is adsorbed by the interaction of the π orbitals of the unsaturation in the alkyl chains with the d orbitals on the bronze surface, the head polar binding through heteroatom with the Cu (I) formed on the bronze surface by copper oxidation. Furthermore, the stable formation of the organometallic complex stabilizes the corrosion products formed on the bronze surface by electrostatic interaction, forming a non-homogeneous protective layer, which follows a Freundlich-type adsorption isotherm in a physisorption adsorption mechanism.

The morphology of the different oxides formed on the bronze surface using the inhibitor at different concentrations was analyzed by SEM. In the micrographs of 50 ppm, a patina formed on the bronze’s surface was deposited per the bronze’s microstructure, indicating a stable protective layer. This observation coincides with the highest inhibition efficiency found at 50 ppm, indicating that the inhibitor stabilizes the protective oxide layer at this concentration to protect the bronze against acid rain adequately. The principal oxides formed on the surface of the bronze when exposed to acid rain corrosion were analyzed by XRD and Raman spectroscopy. Cuprite was the main product observed in XRD without an inhibitor. Tenorite was the main compound observed in Raman spectroscopy for the different inhibitor concentrations due to cuprite oxidation upon contact with air. Cassiterite and covellite nanocrystals were also detected on the surface of the bronze, as well as a small formation of antlerite, nantokite, and rouaite.

**1. 2021年8月，Tesla AI Day**

2021年8月，在首届[AI Day](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=2&q=AI+Day&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiJBSSBEYXkiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MiwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.vfbbRPbuVQ3Ta5OHJuZfZzscPq19pEPVSwSSf02xj44&zhida_source=entity)上，[马斯克](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E9%A9%AC%E6%96%AF%E5%85%8B&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLpqazmlq_lhYsiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.gpFyrdJk45s8jlz1T2XVZp3-d3ZjfzbKWk3U3BQor_8&zhida_source=entity)发布了特斯拉人形机器人计划，并提出人形机器人概念：Tesla Bot。

![Image 1: A Tesla Bot is shown standing in the center of a dark screen, with its specifications listed to the right, including its height of 5'8, weight of 125 lbs, speed of 5 mph, carry capacity of 45 lbs, deadlift of 150 lbs, and arm extend lift of 10 lbs. Text on the left side of the screen states that the world is built by humans, for humans, that the bot is friendly, and that it eliminates dangerous, repetitive, and boring tasks. A small video feed in the bottom left corner shows a man speaking at a podium](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-905fda944d3283ef066f7407b8e1187b_1440w.jpg)

根据马斯克介绍，该机器人将设计成：身高5英尺8英寸(≈1.72m)，体重125英镑(约合56.7kg)。另外，[特斯拉](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=2&q=%E7%89%B9%E6%96%AF%E6%8B%89&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLnibnmlq_mi4kiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MiwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.FQ2HWUaz38M_aINaD4jJ9hhzHP9GacOZX5lIK4BnC9U&zhida_source=entity)计划将于2022年推出该款机器人的原型机（即Optimus原型机），并将此类机器人定位为“[通用型机器人](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E9%80%9A%E7%94%A8%E5%9E%8B%E6%9C%BA%E5%99%A8%E4%BA%BA&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLpgJrnlKjlnovmnLrlmajkuroiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.NyDNmZbtituMUqh9BrhXI90Oq6MnjH-pXfGNFf2Nu6M&zhida_source=entity)”，在未来将会去代替人类从事“危险、重复、无聊”的工作。

![Image 2: A diagram illustrates the technical details of a humanoid robot, highlighting its specifications such as height, weight, number of electromechanical actuators, and features like human-level hands and force feedback sensing](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-932f3d9cf00a7673c290e3069a3c7f6c_1440w.jpg)

**1）现场展示：**在现场展示环节，机器人从舞台后方缓缓走出，依次完成行走、停止、挥手问候、转身等亮相动作，中间还表演了简单的舞蹈。

除原型机外，特斯拉还展示了接近量产的第一代Optimus。其执行器、电池组、控制器等关键核心零部件均由特斯拉自主研发。不过，受限于研发周期，在 AI Day 举办时该机器人尚未完全完工，出场时由几名工作人员推上舞台。马斯克透露，预计再过几周，第一代 Optimus 就能实现自主行走。

此外，马斯克坦言，Optimus 在设计之初便沿用了与汽车一致的[设计理念](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%AE%BE%E8%AE%A1%E7%90%86%E5%BF%B5&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLorr7orqHnkIblv7UiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.TMv9-Kf1QK3Y2VvMyzctArvHVmBanbbZ4dvUQAKNhCg&zhida_source=entity) —— 以量产为目标，最终实现低成本与高性能的平衡。他还预测，待 Optimus 产量达数百万台后，其价格可低至 2 万美元。

与此同时，马斯克还勾勒了一幅美好愿景。他指出，[经济总量](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%BB%8F%E6%B5%8E%E6%80%BB%E9%87%8F&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLnu4_mtY7mgLvph48iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.xGEBFBJhcs8zWl1VJ41sFjo3jP1xK3oXXkIOdKfdoQs&zhida_source=entity)由“生产者数量” 乘以 “[平均生产力](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%B9%B3%E5%9D%87%E7%94%9F%E4%BA%A7%E5%8A%9B&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLlubPlnYfnlJ_kuqflipsiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.39PnUNlMX6UPITb7KPa5PTeOfKR-axoLCS-g1mABKEU&zhida_source=entity)” 决定，若生产者数量不受限制，经济总量将趋近于无限，未来社会有望彻底消除贫穷。这意味着，随着机器人的大规模量产，社会劳动力短缺问题将不复存在 —— 人们在产品和服务层面能够获得所需的一切，而这一变革将从根本上重塑人类已知的文明形态。

**特斯拉人形机器人设计原则：**以人体仿生设计为核心（基于人类形态与功能设计），同时最大程度复用汽车领域的资源（造车积累的经验、技术与[供应链](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E4%BE%9B%E5%BA%94%E9%93%BE&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLkvpvlupTpk74iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.r3uVhUKC40109hrD0jloraIwHFHaCKkzEQ6fXbzFRoo&zhida_source=entity)资源）。

**1）人体仿生研究**

**A. 膝关节设计：**Optimus 的膝关节模仿人类膝盖骨结构，采用了类似于四连杆机构的设计，尽量复刻[生物学](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%94%9F%E7%89%A9%E5%AD%A6&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLnlJ_nianlraYiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.CmiHDEYUdOlolozQD7FlOAq1vr7DFa4LHx9WTpltrd0&zhida_source=entity)上的 “非线性” 逻辑，贴合[膝关节](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=3&q=%E8%86%9D%E5%85%B3%E8%8A%82&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLohp3lhbPoioIiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MywiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.5HSvKzrvTldehI3dIqiBo0zIs90ILLO-C7BwLB0M3QY&zhida_source=entity)从直立到完全弯曲时的受力曲线，这样的设计可以使 Optimus 在行走、下蹲等动作中，能够更有效地利用力量，并且动作姿态更自然、更节能，从而更好地模拟人类的运动方式。

![Image 8: 动图封面](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-9ad2d1231e1909ef435f7d0862319c23_b.jpg)

**B. 低频率运动设计：**人类日常行走的频率通常处于[低赫兹](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E4%BD%8E%E8%B5%AB%E5%85%B9&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLkvY7otavlhbkiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.QNIsVUr2rs6GMk4g7hvjrBGSn1Gxit5_UP8Nz2EVyhY&zhida_source=entity)范围，属于低频率运动。这种运动方式节奏舒缓，能让身体各部位有序配合，以较低能耗维持长时间移动。而机器人要实现低频率运动，每一个动作细节都被放大，对动作的精准度、连贯性以及稳定性要求极高，控制难度也随之大幅提升。在这次发布会上，特斯拉虽然提及了Optimus 在运动控制上采用了仿生人体低频率运动的设计理念，但并未披露更细节的设计方案。

![Image 9: 动图封面](https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-6a02918e3dc29412cef49bd046602c83_b.jpg)

**C. 灵巧手设计：**Optimus 的手部采用仿生的五指结构设计，通过金属腱绳传动实现自适应抓握功能；其手部共配备 6 个关节、11 个自由度（其中，拇指 3 个、其余四指各 2 个），此外还采用反向自锁设计，可使手指在断电状态下依然维持抓握形态，进一步强化了灵巧手的实用性和可靠性。

![Image 10: 动图封面](https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-d67186cd18e634e4ec16b4a08d6d200b_b.jpg)

**2）汽车领域技术和经验的复用**

**A. Autopilot系统：**Optimus使用的中央大脑计算SoC芯片、摄像头以及[神经网络模型](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%A5%9E%E7%BB%8F%E7%BD%91%E7%BB%9C%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLnpZ7nu4_nvZHnu5zmqKHlnosiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.fin9Wm29WHrP_9ueCrObro0DIHec795-GvbefflInLc&zhida_source=entity)（如占用网络），均直接复用自动驾驶系统。但是，对于数据，则需要重新收集，以适配机器人的应用场景。

另外，还需要通过[神经辐射场](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%A5%9E%E7%BB%8F%E8%BE%90%E5%B0%84%E5%9C%BA&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLnpZ7nu4_ovpDlsITlnLoiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.U3cvKC-XE94kxEgmis09b8zfgqcSX8XD9W4sMGJuKNU&zhida_source=entity)（Neural Radiance Field ,NeRF）技术对“占用网络”进行优化。可使其在机器人运行环境中生成更精准的体积深度渲染结果，提升[环境感知](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%8E%AF%E5%A2%83%E6%84%9F%E7%9F%A5&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLnjq_looPmhJ_nn6UiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.NE_ft6lt__YJFUvNEj7YjaVh812hrjsOTyf3zQH2v9I&zhida_source=entity)的立体感与细节精度。

![Image 11: 动图封面](https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-51c0381811f3e92b17976b7b864081c9_b.jpg)

2023年9月，特斯拉发布视频展示了Optimus的**手臂和腿的自我校准、物品自主分类、单脚保持平衡**等能力。

**1）手臂和腿的自我校准：**Optimus 通过多模态感知融合与端到端神经网络控制协同，实现腿和手臂的精准自我校准。在数据采集阶段，视觉传感器持续捕捉周围环境画面，同时记录腿、手臂在空间中的相对位置；高精度关节位置编码器则实时监测腿和手臂各关节的旋转角度、位移量等[运动参数](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%BF%90%E5%8A%A8%E5%8F%82%E6%95%B0&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLov5Dliqjlj4LmlbAiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.rpeBSSoO53Y8r-Kxyub2BsWi1jQJ8KHIHOv2dE3qTlg&zhida_source=entity)。

获取数据后，视觉传感器采集的图像数据与关节编码器记录的运动参数，会同步输入经过端到端训练的神经网络。借助多[传感器融合](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E4%BC%A0%E6%84%9F%E5%99%A8%E8%9E%8D%E5%90%88&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLkvKDmhJ_lmajono3lkIgiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.MBjajkGJnBcSfZGzHfM0Z9tHZiNVj9p8cok22t3xY-0&zhida_source=entity)技术，神经网络整合两类数据，构建出腿和手臂的三维运动模型，直观呈现肢体的实时状态。

最后，神经网络会对比模型中肢体的实际位置与目标位置，计算出两者的偏差。基于[偏差值](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E5%81%8F%E5%B7%AE%E5%80%BC&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLlgY_lt67lgLwiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.wXHkk1Nfg3er-BSaYsOTim0YhgYQ7xvEhjd9OwfiOUE&zhida_source=entity)，神经网络生成精确的关节扭矩、速度等控制指令，驱动电机调整腿和手臂的关节运动，不断修正肢体位置，直至达到目标定位，完成自我校准。

## 四、**2024年：最新一代22自由度灵巧手发布**

**6. 2024年5月，特斯拉在X平台发布Optimus最新进展**

2024年5月5日，Tesla Optimus 官方账号在社交媒体 X 上发布了机器人分拣电池的视频。

**从视频看技术进展：**

**1）端到端神经网络驱动的自主分拣**

Optimus 通过完全端到端的神经网络直接处理 2D 摄像头、手部触觉及力传感器数据，无需中间编程逻辑即可生成关节控制序列。视频中，机器人能精准识别特斯拉电池的形状、位置，并将其插入托盘中，动作精度达到工业级标准 —— 在插入电芯时的容错率极低，神经网络可自动定位下一个空闲槽位。

Optimus 接网球视频

根据特斯拉机Optimus项目副总裁Milan Kovac透露，此次展示的灵巧手拥有22个自由度，手腕和前臂部分也增加了3个自由度**（手腕和前臂各有3个自由度）**，这种设计使得整个手臂系统更加灵活，使其能够更容易完成抓握、松开等复杂动作。

**从视频看技术进展：**

**1）多部位协同运动：**接球过程中，机器人不仅依靠手部动作，还需协调身体姿态、左臂摆动及头部动作以保持平衡，动作连贯性接近人类。

**2）高速[视觉识别](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%A7%86%E8%A7%89%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLop4bop4nor4bliKsiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.aEuSDzUPbTfpHXm2ltOdeDr0COpYyxL5u6dCmMwyHJU&zhida_source=entity)与反馈能力：**要成功完成隔空接住网球的任务，Optimus需要具备高速度的视觉识别与反馈能力。网球的运动轨迹变化迅速且难以预测，这要求机器人必须具备极高的响应速度和精确度。Optimus在这方面的表现令人印象深刻，证明了其在复杂任务处理上的巨大潜力。

**3）手指手掌的柔韧性和保护层：**为了稳定地完成接球动作，Optimus的手指和手掌需要具备足够的柔韧性和顺从性，同时还需要一个稳定的外保护层。这些特性共同确保了机器人能够在不损伤自身的情况下，准确而可靠地抓住快速移动的物体。

**局限性：**自主性尚未完全实现，视频中的动作依赖[远程操作](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%BF%9C%E7%A8%8B%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLov5znqIvmk43kvZwiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.R0QW6Qfmh3r1sER3V8bkEjKE_JsuvN2GShn6uYPcqBQ&zhida_source=entity)，而非完全自主决策。视频虽通过远程操作完成，但低延迟特性（接近实时响应）验证了其运控系统的可靠性，为未来完全自主操作奠定了基础。

Milan Kovac发文称，接下来的改进方向是扩大手部触觉感受面积，肌腱的精细控制，以及前臂减重等。另外就是在不影响触觉[感受器](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%84%9F%E5%8F%97%E5%99%A8&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLmhJ_lj5flmagiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.sQdXYyIMGmHtO_oxb5QUYcDqfheu81vXN0aFfU6qdyw&zhida_source=entity)的敏感度的前提下，让手指和手掌拥有足够柔软度/柔顺性的保护层。

Optimus 野外上下坡视频

特斯拉Optimus 项目副总裁米兰・科瓦奇（Milan Kovic）转发该视频时，透露了一些关键技术细节：机器人在全程未启用视觉系统的情况下，完全依靠自身的平衡能力来应对复杂地形（据业内人士推断可能是基于脚部六维力传感器 + 关节力矩反馈构成的纯力学感知闭环实现平衡控制）。

另外，他还特别指出，他自己曾在 Optimus 行走的位置滑倒过，更加凸显了该地形的复杂程度。而 Optimus 凭借动态扭矩调整算法和仿生[踝关节](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%B8%9D%E5%85%B3%E8%8A%82&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLouJ3lhbPoioIiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.vL8W8vDJtOyx0leJLO6gdMhHuVC2EA7AWA9h4XzhcwE&zhida_source=entity)缓冲结构，不仅以稳定步速完成斜坡上下行，更在突发打滑时通过下肢肌肉模拟驱动实现动态纠偏，展现了较强的反应速度的地形适应能力。

**从视频看技术进展：**

*   **强大的平衡能力**：Optimus 在没有使用视觉系统的情况下，仅依靠自身的平衡能力应对复杂地形。它在上下坡过程中，尽管姿势略显笨拙，但步速与普通人差不多，且全程没有摔倒。有一次下坡时虽略有脚滑，但其下肢和上肢迅速作出反应，保持了平衡。这表明特斯拉在机器人的力控感知和平衡控制技术方面取得了显著进步。
*   **较强的自学习能力：**特斯拉团队选择了三个地点进行下坡实验，在同一地点第二次下坡时，Optimus 的动作整体上要比第一次下坡时更流畅。从最陡的一个坡做实验时，第一次下坡时，Optimus“脚底打滑”，差点摔倒；然而，第二次下坡时，却是以流畅的动作完成了下坡。这展示了Optimus具有强大的自学习能力，神经网络模型从一次行走中学习并改进下一次的表现，体现了特斯拉在机器人自主学习和优化行为模式方面的技术进步。

另外，特斯拉Optimus 项目副总裁Milan Kovic进一步透露，团队正围绕四个方向[推进技术](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%8E%A8%E8%BF%9B%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLmjqjov5vmioDmnK8iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.8MBm72EIAMUZgla2hcniqoa4ayFxcdporinULQDx6iM&zhida_source=entity)迭代：

*   **融入视觉感知，**让机器人能够更好地提前做好动作规划。
*   **运动控制优化，**让机器人在崎岖地形中实现更自然的步态。
*   **提升动态响应速度，**让机器人对速度/方向指令反应更灵敏。
*   **防摔倒自我保护机制，**尽量避免摔倒，即使在机器人预判到不可避免的摔倒时，能够自动实施保护措施，将伤害降至最低，并且还能再自动站立起来。

**10. 2025年5月，特斯拉在X平台发布Optimus最新进展**

2025年5月14日，特斯拉机器人官方账号在X平台上发布Optimus最新跳舞视频。视频中，机器人开场便以单腿站立的芭蕾舞姿亮相，流畅完成鬼步舞、机械舞等多种[舞蹈风格](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%88%9E%E8%B9%88%E9%A3%8E%E6%A0%BC&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLoiJ7ouYjpo47moLwiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.3xHtqaARyLw-9VJMg1IX6ZP2CkTWmb1LZW2AA2uxJDg&zhida_source=entity)动作，尤其是完成了高难度的单脚旋转动作。其姿态优雅、动作协调，细腻程度直逼人类舞者。

![Image 36: A white and black humanoid robot is dancing with its arms outstretched](https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-1cc7570485b8aee145bd007074a3b76c.jpg?source=25ab7b06)

Optimus 流畅的舞蹈表演

视频一经发布便引起了轰动，甚至有不少人怀疑是经过渲染加工过的假视频。随后，特斯拉Optimus副总裁Milan Kovac在X平台上出面澄清：视频为 100% 实拍，既无电缆连接，也未使用特效或进行加速处理，所有动作均源于机器人实时自主控制。

机器人所展示的舞蹈动作，完全通过仿真训练生成，100% 是在仿真环境中学习所得，无需额外借助真实数据进行微调，也没有人类远程干预。

**从视频看技术进展**

**1）Sim-to-real RL（从仿真到现实的强化学习）：**这项技术通过在虚拟环境中[模拟现实](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E7%8E%B0%E5%AE%9E&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLmqKHmi5_njrDlrp4iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.2frF6p40bwLRmmLJRF-HBcoVCIi1yOXBHXujtttp-sA&zhida_source=entity)物理规则，构建数百万种可能的物理场景。先在模拟环境中训练AI模型，然后再将学到的策略直接应用到现实世界的机器人系统中。

在模拟仿真环境中，擎天柱（Optimus）的AI系统经历海量试错与策略优化，学习如何在动态平衡中完成复杂动作（如单腿站立、旋转、滑步等），随后将虚拟环境中习得的[控制策略](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E6%8E%A7%E5%88%B6%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLmjqfliLbnrZbnlaUiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.s-sW5bx9idnKX9zTaYhY65vcN2g7XFYfiBh8MXmeYQg&zhida_source=entity)直接迁移至现实世界的机器人本体。

挑战在于模拟和现实之间的差距（Sim-to-Real Gap）。特斯拉可能在跨越这种差距的技术上实现重大进展。例如通过改进[物理引擎](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%89%A9%E7%90%86%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLniannkIblvJXmk44iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.F6n-L7pxMbx872vsAEexee3ktEDp0H05F_vdBTnW8Rk&zhida_source=entity)建模精度、增强传感器反馈校准算法等，实现了虚拟训练成果到真实机器人动作的高效映射。

**2）[Zero-shot](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=Zero-shot&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiJaZXJvLXNob3QiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.OAJG3_QnZnZhOGH2EdEgqro4y9p9c5mXww0nJXG1CCU&zhida_source=entity)（“零样本”学习）：**指模型无需接触真实环境数据，便可直接将模拟环境中习得的策略应用于现实场景并完成任务。

这意味着Optimus 的AI模型具备极强的泛化性 —— 其无需依赖额外的现实世界数据进行微调，即可将虚拟训练中掌握的动作控制逻辑（如平衡算法、运动[轨迹规划](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E8%BD%A8%E8%BF%B9%E8%A7%84%E5%88%92&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLovajov7nop4TliJIiLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.aK71_7GtZHpolu1Xu2ff3wmUSVGnbxOnuUXwkfbn2zQ&zhida_source=entity)等）直接复用到物理机器人，实现从仿真到现实的 “无缝迁移”。

**3）推理计算全部由Optimus单机完成：**系统无需依赖外部服务器或云端计算资源，从感知环境、决策规划到动作控制均在设备端实时完成。这不仅展现了Optimus 高效的[硬件性能](https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=258017724&content_type=Article&match_order=1&q=%E7%A1%AC%E4%BB%B6%E6%80%A7%E8%83%BD&zd_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJ6aGlkYV9zZXJ2ZXIiLCJleHAiOjE3ODc3NDUwNjcsInEiOiLnoazku7bmgKfog70iLCJ6aGlkYV9zb3VyY2UiOiJlbnRpdHkiLCJjb250ZW50X2lkIjoyNTgwMTc3MjQsImNvbnRlbnRfdHlwZSI6IkFydGljbGUiLCJtYXRjaF9vcmRlciI6MSwiemRfdG9rZW4iOm51bGx9.8MMRRmi1BAo5D2CUnLu1ERZ2XA_VdJH6S9WrWhPDYnQ&zhida_source=entity)与优化的算法，更体现了其具备极强的量产潜力与实际应用价值 —— 本地化计算架构可大幅降低对外部基础设施的依赖，进而为复杂场景下的自主作业和规模化部署奠定基础。

Figure Exceeds $1B in Series C Funding at $39B Post-Money Valuation

Figure Exceeds $1B in Series C Funding at $39B Post-Money Valuation

Today we’re announcing that we have exceeded more than $1 billion in committed capital through our Series C financing round, at a post-money valuation of $39 billion. The funding will accelerate our efforts to bring general-purpose humanoid robots into real-world environments at scale.

The round was led by Parkway Venture Capital with significant investment from Brookfield Asset Management, NVIDIA, Macquarie Capital, Intel Capital, Align Ventures, Tamarack Global, LG Technology Ventures, Salesforce, T-Mobile Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures.

This milestone is critical to unlocking the next stage of growth for humanoid robots, scaling out our AI platform Helix and BotQ manufacturing. Support from new partners, alongside the continued backing of our existing investors, reflects both Figure’s position as the market leader and a shared belief in a future where this technology becomes a natural part of daily life.

This capital raise milestone supports our momentum across three core areas—all designed to unlock the full capabilities of Helix, our AI system for embodied intelligence:

*   _Scaling humanoid robots into homes and commercial operations._ We are expanding production manufacturing at BotQ and real-world deployments, enabling robots to assist with household and commercial workforce tasks.

*   _Building next-generation GPU infrastructure to accelerate training and simulation._ This compute foundation will power Helix’s core models for perception, reasoning, and control.

*   _Launching advanced data collection efforts._ These include data collection of human video and multimodal sensory inputs, to improve how robots understand and operate in complex, dynamic settings. These real-world datasets are essential to scaling Helix’s capabilities.

If you would like to help us solve general robotics, please consider applying [here](http://www.figure.ai/careers).

# Robotics Funding Crests Higher As Figure Lands Another $1B

[Joanna Glasner](https://news.crunchbase.com/author/joanna/)

September 16, 2025

![Image 5: Illustration of AI/Human teamwork. [Dom Guzman]](https://news.crunchbase.com/wp-content/uploads/AI-cowork-990x557.jpg)

![Image 6: A drawing of a person with long brown hair, blue eyes, and light skin against an orange background](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/98dd18e3aa3c9315aa97187f1345ff039c2f53df430291eca6f33194bd8fd454?s=112&d=mm&r=g)[Joanna Glasner](https://news.crunchbase.com/author/joanna/)[jglasner](http://www.twitter.com/jglasner)

Robotics startup funding has hit the highest point in years, boosted by another giant round for a developer of humanoid bots.

On Tuesday, San Jose, California-based [Figure](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/figure-b5dc#overview), the developer of general purpose humanoid robots, [announced](https://www.figure.ai/news/series-c) that it raised $1 billion in Series C financing. The round, led by [Parkway Venture Capital](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/parkway-venture-capital), set a $39 billion post-money valuation for the company.

Figure, founded in 2022 by [Archer](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/archer-b2aa) founder [Brett Adcock](https://www.crunchbase.com/person/brett-adcock), plans to use the Series C money to scale its artificial intelligence platform and manufacturing capabilities. Other investors in the round include [Brookfield Asset Management](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/brookfield-asset-management), [Nvidia](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/nvidia), [Macquarie Capital](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/macquarie-capital-funds), [Intel Capital](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/intel-capital), [Align Ventures](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/alignventures), [Tamarack Global](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/tamarack-global), [LG Technology Ventures](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/lg-technology-ventures), [Salesforce](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/salesforce)

[1](https://news.crunchbase.com/robotics/ai-funding-high-figure-raise-data#footnote-1-92336), [T-Mobile Ventures](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/t-mobile-ventures), and [Qualcomm Ventures](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/qualcomm-ventures).
The startup is currently working on bots that can assist in household tasks as well as in the commercial workforce.

It’s both an extraordinarily ambitious and costly mission. That helps explain why the round qualifies as the largest robotics-related financing of 2025, per Crunchbase [data](https://www.crunchbase.com/discover/saved/robotics-startup-funding/e82d6812-9b5e-4d47-8613-0bf059391b0b).

Figure’s financing also bumped up total funding to the sector to more than $8.5 billion this year. That puts the space on track for its largest fundraising haul since 2021.

## Other big fundraisers

While Figure is the only robotics startup to raise a billion-dollar round this year, several others have raised rounds in the hundreds of millions. U.S. funding to the space has been particularly strong, as illustrated below in a sample list of the largest funding recipients of the year.

This includes [Neuralink](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/neuralink), the developer of implantable brain-computer interfaces, which raised $650 million in a financing deal reported in May. While Neuralink isn’t a pure-play robotics company, it has applications in the space, including surgical robots for implanting its devices and technology to allow recipients of its implants to control robotic prosthetic limbs.

[Apptronik](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/apptronik), a spinoff from [The University of Texas at Austin](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/the-university-of-texas-at-austin?_gl=1*8gdo8i*_gcl_au*NTEzNDI1MTgwLjE3NTEyOTEyNjcuMTI1NDY4NDAxMS4xNzU2OTEwNTQwLjE3NTY5MTA1Mzk.*_ga*MjAzODAwMzgwMi4xNzQzNDI5MzYx*_ga_97DKWJJNRK*czE3NTgwNDA1NDEkbzc5MSRnMSR0MTc1ODA0NDA3MyRqNDkkbDAkaDA.) known for its flagship Apollo robot, was also in demand, securing $403 million in Series A and extension funding, led by [B Capital](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/b-capital-group?_gl=1*8gdo8i*_gcl_au*NTEzNDI1MTgwLjE3NTEyOTEyNjcuMTI1NDY4NDAxMS4xNzU2OTEwNTQwLjE3NTY5MTA1Mzk.*_ga*MjAzODAwMzgwMi4xNzQzNDI5MzYx*_ga_97DKWJJNRK*czE3NTgwNDA1NDEkbzc5MSRnMSR0MTc1ODA0NDA3MyRqNDkkbDAkaDA.) and [Capital Factory](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/capital-factory?_gl=1*8gdo8i*_gcl_au*NTEzNDI1MTgwLjE3NTEyOTEyNjcuMTI1NDY4NDAxMS4xNzU2OTEwNTQwLjE3NTY5MTA1Mzk.*_ga*MjAzODAwMzgwMi4xNzQzNDI5MzYx*_ga_97DKWJJNRK*czE3NTgwNDA1NDEkbzc5MSRnMSR0MTc1ODA0NDA3MyRqNDkkbDAkaDA.).

[Field AI](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/field-ai#overview), a developer of AI systems for operating autonomous robots, was another major fundraiser, picking up $405 million across two consecutive rounds [announced](https://www.fieldai.com/news/fieldai-announces-over-400m-in-funds-raised-to-advance-embodied-ai-at-scale) in August. The Irvine, California, startup counts [Bezos Expeditions](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/bezos-expeditions) among its lead investors.

[The Bot Co.](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/the-bot-company), which is focused on every person’s dream of robots that can do household chores, also picked up a big round. The San Francisco startup, founded last year, closed on $150 million in March, bringing total funding to date to $300 million.

## Funding outpaces exits

Even as funding accelerates, we aren’t seeing much in the way of large-scale robotics acquisitions and IPOs this year. That’s not surprising, given that so many of investors’ most sought-after startups are still early stage.

Moreover, a traditional IPO or M&A deal isn’t the only way to measure success for these startups, particularly in an age when so many unicorns are staying private longer. Instead, what might get both investors and the rest of us excited would be the introduction of an affordable bot capable of doing more of our least favorite tasks.

**Figure AI, Inc.** is an American [robotics company](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robotics_company "Robotics company") developing [humanoid robots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Humanoid_robot "Humanoid robot") that operate via [artificial intelligence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence "Artificial intelligence"). The company was founded in 2022 by [Brett Adcock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brett_Adcock "Brett Adcock"). As of late 2025, the company had a $39 billion valuation.

Three generations of humanoid robots (Figure 01–03) have been developed, as well as two iterations of a [vision–language–action model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vision%E2%80%93language%E2%80%93action_model "Vision–language–action model") (Helix 01–02), which can control up to two robots at once. By 2026, the robots demonstrated the potential ability to perform household work and the company gained publicity when a Figure 03 appeared at a [White House](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_House "White House") event.

Figure AI was founded in 2022 by [Brett Adcock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brett_Adcock "Brett Adcock"), also known for founding [Archer Aviation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archer_Aviation "Archer Aviation"), [Vettery](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vettery "Vettery") and Hark.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:0-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:1-3) That year, the company introduced its prototype, Figure 01, a [bipedal robot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bipedal_robot "Bipedal robot") designed for manual labor, initially targeting the [logistics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Logistics "Logistics") and [warehousing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warehousing "Warehousing") sectors.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-4) The initial model utilized external cabling for easier maintenance.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:6-5) In May 2023, Figure AI raised $70 million from investors including Adcock, who invested $20 million, and Parkway Venture Capital.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-6) In January 2024, Figure AI announced a partnership with [BMW](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW "BMW") to deploy humanoid robots in [automotive manufacturing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Automotive_manufacturing "Automotive manufacturing") facilities.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-7)

In February 2024, Figure AI secured $675 million in venture capital funding from a consortium that includes [Jeff Bezos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeff_Bezos "Jeff Bezos"), [Microsoft](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microsoft "Microsoft"), [Nvidia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nvidia "Nvidia"), [Intel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intel "Intel"), and the startup-funding divisions of [Amazon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_(company) "Amazon (company)") and [OpenAI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenAI "OpenAI");[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:0-2)[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:2-9) the company was then valued at $2.6 billion.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:0-2) Figure AI also announced a partnership with OpenAI, which would build specialized [artificial intelligence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence "Artificial intelligence") (AI) models for Figure AI's humanoid robots, enabling its robots to process language;[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:2-9) the collaboration ended after a year, with Adcock stating that [large language models](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model "Large language model") had become a smaller problem compared to those allowing for "high rate robot control".[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-10)

In August 2024, the company introduced Figure 02, describing it as the next step toward deploying humanoids for industrial use.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:6-5) Its five-fingered hands have 16 [degrees of freedom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Degrees_of_freedom_(mechanics) "Degrees of freedom (mechanics)") (DOF) and the ability to carry up to 25 kilograms (55 lb).[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:6-5)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:3-11) The model is equipped with cabling integrated into the limbs, a torso-placed battery, six [RGB](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RGB_color_model "RGB color model") cameras, and an onboard [vision–language–action](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vision%E2%80%93language%E2%80%93action_model "Vision–language–action model") (VLA) model.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:6-5) It has three times the computing power (including [inference](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inference_engine "Inference engine") AI) of the previous model, including two [graphics processing units](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graphics_processing_unit "Graphics processing unit"), supported by Nvidia.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:6-5)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:3-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-12) Microphones, speakers, and custom AI models (developed with OpenAI) enable communication with humans.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:6-5)

In early 2025, Figure AI announced BotQ, a manufacturing facility aiming to produce 12,000 humanoids per year with the help of its own humanoid robots, and Helix, a VLA model that can control up to two robots at once.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:3-11)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-14) Helix enables a robot to interact with the world without extensive manual training,[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:3-11) according to the company allowing it to pick up nearly any small household object.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:3-11) By April, the company issued cease-and-desist letters to at least two secondary brokers promoting its private stock without authorization.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-15) In September, a third round of financing exceeded $1 billion, raising the company's total valuation to $39 billion. Investors included [Brookfield Asset Management](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brookfield_Asset_Management "Brookfield Asset Management"), Intel, [Macquarie Capital](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macquarie_Capital "Macquarie Capital"), Nvidia, Parkway Venture Capital, [Qualcomm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qualcomm "Qualcomm"), [Salesforce](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salesforce "Salesforce"), and [T-Mobile](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-Mobile_US "T-Mobile US").[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-18)

In October 2025, Figure 03 was introduced.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-auto-19) Standing 5+1⁄2 feet (1.7 meters) tall, the machine has 60 total DOF,[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-20) including 20 for each hand.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-21) According to the company, its hardware and software redesign aims to create a general-purpose robot able to learn directly from humans. An upgraded camera system delivers twice the [frame rate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frame_rate "Frame rate"), a quarter the latency, and a 60% wider [field of view](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Field_of_view "Field of view"), in addition to a camera in each hand.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:5-22)[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-auto-19)[Tactile sensors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tactile_sensor "Tactile sensor") in the fingertips can detect forces as little as 3 grams (0.1 oz).[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:5-22) It incorporates [soft materials](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soft_robotics "Soft robotics") and a protected battery for safety, as well as removable, washable textiles. It supports wireless [inductive charging](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inductive_charging "Inductive charging").[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-auto-19)

In November 2025, the former head of product safety sued the company on the basis of being fired for raising the concern that the company's robots were strong enough to fracture a human skull.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:4-23) By early 2026, Figure 02 had been used in demonstrations showing that it could load a [washing machine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washing_machine "Washing machine"), sort packages, and fold laundry. That January, Helix 02 was released, expanding the AI model to the entire body to allow for functional autonomy.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-24) A Helix 02–powered Figure 02 was shown to be capable of loading and unloading a [dishwasher](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dishwasher "Dishwasher"), based on hours of [motion-capture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motion-capture "Motion-capture") data and [simulation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robotics_simulator "Robotics simulator")-based [machine learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning "Machine learning").[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-25) In March, U.S. First Lady [Melania Trump](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melania_Trump "Melania Trump") appeared at the [White House](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_House "White House") with a Figure 03, promoting the presumptive eventual ability of AI to teach children.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-:4-23)

By April 2026, the company had delivered over 350 Figure 03 models and increased its production output to one robot every hour.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-26) That May, Adcock stated that the company would soon lease the robot for domestic use for around $600 a month.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-27) Additionally, a group of Figure 03 robots was [livestreamed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Livestreamed "Livestreamed") processing packages for almost a full week, inspiring a 10-hour competition between their product and a person; the robot performed 98.5% as well as the human.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-28)[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-29) By the end of June 2026, the company had about 740 robots operating, as opposed to only 600 humans.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-employs-1) That August, Adcock shared a video of a Figure 03 climbing a short ladder.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure_AI#cite_note-30)

## Valuation & Funding

In September 2025, [1X Technologies](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/) entered talks with investors and employees about raising up to $1 billion in new funding at a targeted valuation of at least $10 billion, more than 12x its January 2024 valuation.

[1X Technologies](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/) raised $100 million in Series B funding in January 2024. EQT Ventures led the round, with participation from Samsung NEXT, OpenAI Startup Fund, and Tiger Global.

In March 2023, the company raised $23.5 million in a Series A2 round led by [OpenAI](https://sacra.com/c/openai/) Startup Fund, with Tiger Global also participating. Earlier funding rounds included investments from Norwegian firms Nistad Group, Sandwater, and Skagerak Capital.

Total funding to date amounts to approximately $136.5 million across all rounds. In July 2025, the company relocated its global headquarters from Norway to Palo Alto to leverage Silicon Valley talent and investor networks, while continuing manufacturing operations in Norway.

## Product

[1X Technologies](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/) builds two humanoid robots designed to operate alongside humans in various environments.

[EVE](https://sacra.com/c/eve/) is a 6-foot-tall, 183-pound wheeled humanoid robot that incorporates a self-balancing two-wheel base and 25 degrees of freedom across its arms and neck. It is designed for industrial and institutional tasks, including nighttime security patrols, light logistics, and hospital supply runs. Security operators can manage multiple [EVE](https://sacra.com/c/eve/) units via a browser dashboard, which provides live 360-degree video feeds and allows for direct control when necessary.

NEO Gamma is a fully bipedal home robot, standing 5 feet 7 inches tall and weighing 66 pounds. It features a soft 3D-knit exterior, walks with a human-like gait, and can squat, sit, and manipulate objects using five-fingered hands. LED ear rings and an onboard speaker array enable non-verbal feedback and conversational interaction. Current task speeds require approximately 2 minutes to fold a sweater or 5 minutes to load three dishes, with near-term operation largely via vetted teleoperators using VR and app-scheduled sessions. NEO is available for purchase at $20,000 (with delivery expected in late 2026) or via a $499/month rental plan (six-month minimum), with early adopter preorders open as of late 2025. In a separate enterprise channel, [1X](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/) signed a deal with EQT to deploy up to 10,000 NEO robots across EQT's 300+ portfolio companies between 2026 and 2030.

Both robots operate on Redwood, [1X](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/)'s proprietary vision-language transformer, which processes input from stereo depth cameras, microphone arrays, and tactile joint sensors. The AI system converts high-level decisions into precise joint movements through a 100Hz whole-body controller. Complementing Redwood, [1X](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/)'s [1X](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/)WM world model — a 14-billion-parameter video-pretrained system — maps text plus a starting frame into predicted future video frames, then uses an inverse dynamics model trained on approximately 400 hours of robot data to convert those imagined futures into executable action trajectories. This enables NEO to simulate possible futures, evaluate alternative action sequences, and learn from virtual failures before real-world execution.

The robots are powered by proprietary Revo1 quasi-direct-drive motors with cable transmissions instead of gears, allowing for low-friction movement and safe interaction during human contact. Human operators can train new behaviors by using VR headsets and haptic gloves to demonstrate tasks through the robot's cameras. These demonstrations are then used to fine-tune the AI models.

## Business Model

[1X Technologies](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/) operates as a vertically integrated robotics company combining proprietary hardware with AI software. Its business model includes a B2B approach targeting enterprise customers and a B2C strategy for home robots.

The company manufactures its robots in-house, utilizing custom actuators and AI systems. This approach allows control over the entire stack, from mechanical design to behavior learning. Vertical integration facilitates faster iteration between hardware and software as AI models improve through real-world deployment data. Proprietary Revo1 brushless motors, built in-house rather than sourced from Chinese suppliers, provide a cost and safety differentiation that management views as a structural hedge against Chinese component pricing pressure.

Revenue is generated through robot sales and rental subscriptions, following a hardware-plus-software model. The EQT enterprise deployment deal — up to 10,000 NEO units across 300+ portfolio companies from 2026 to 2030 — reflects a dual go-to-market strategy in which EQT functions as both investor and scaled commercial channel. In the consumer segment, the company sells home robots directly and offers a subscription rental tier, with ongoing software updates delivered over-the-air.

The business model relies on continuous learning from deployed robots. Teleoperation is treated as a data collection bootstrap — analogous to human labeling for large language models — rather than a permanent operating dependency. Expert demonstrations feed the 1XWM world model, creating a feedback loop where increased deployments yield richer training data, enabling more autonomous operation over time and reducing the per-unit cost of human oversight.

Manufacturing is based in Norway, with the Revo1 motor program providing cost advantages over competitors dependent on external suppliers. The capital-intensive nature of robotics necessitates substantial upfront investment to achieve economies of scale.

## Competition

The humanoid robotics industry has attracted significant venture and corporate investment, driving competition across varying strategic approaches and form factors.

### Humanoid-first competitors

Tesla operates in this category with its Optimus robot, with over 1,000 units deployed in its own factories. The company utilizes its manufacturing expertise and data collection capabilities, though it faces production challenges including actuator overheating and drivetrain durability issues.

[Figure AI](https://sacra.com/c/figure-ai/) has raised over $2.5 billion at a reported $39 billion valuation and is the most commercially advanced US humanoid company, with 40 Figure 03 robots deployed at BMW's Spartanburg plant and reported discussions with UPS for logistics applications. Figure's Helix vision-language-action platform runs entirely on embedded onboard GPUs and uses fleet learning from industrial deployments as its primary training data engine, with a consumer home timeline that remains aspirational.

[OpenAI](https://sacra.com/c/openai/) has entered the humanoid space through a dedicated robotics division (launched June 2026), making it a direct competitor to [1X](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/). This is notable given that the [OpenAI Startup Fund](https://sacra.com/c/openai/) participated in both [1X](https://sacra.com/c/1x-technologies/)'s Series A2 and Series B funding rounds, creating a simultaneous investor-competitor dynamic.

[Agility Robotics](https://sacra.com/c/agility-robotics/) has launched a 70,000-square-foot manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of 10,000 units for its Digit robot, with pilot programs at Amazon and GXO. [Apptronik](https://sacra.com/c/apptronik/) closed a $403 million Series A and is piloting its Apollo robot at Mercedes-Benz and GXO Logistics.

### Non-humanoid home robot competitors

[Sunday Robotics](https://sacra.com/c/sunday/) raised a $200 million Series B and is developing Memo, a wheeled robot with a telescoping spine and 3-finger grippers targeting a sub-$10,000 price point. Sunday trains its ACT-1 foundation model exclusively on human demonstrations captured via distributed Skill Capture Gloves — with no teleoperation robot data — generating approximately 10 million behavioral trajectories across 1,000+ households, and is targeting a 50-household consumer beta in late 2026.

[The Bot Company](https://sacra.com/c/the-bot-company/), co-founded by former Cruise CEO Kyle Vogt, has raised $300 million at a $4 billion-plus valuation with no units yet shipped. The company rejects bipedal humanoids in favor of a lower-cost non-humanoid form factor, targeting 90–99% reliability on narrow, high-frequency tasks such as toy pickup rather than full-spectrum housekeeping.

### Low-cost hardware and Chinese players

Chinese companies including [Galbot](https://sacra.com/c/galbot/), Fourier Intelligence, and [Unitree Robotics](https://sacra.com/c/unitree/) benefit from structural supply chain advantages in brushless motors, actuators, and magnets that can reduce component costs by 40–60% relative to Western manufacturers. [Galbot](https://sacra.com/c/galbot/) has secured several thousand unit orders from tier-one industrial clients including CATL, Bosch, Toyota, BAIC, and SAIC, and raised approximately $650 million across rounds in late 2025 and March 2026 at a valuation above $2.9 billion. Unitree's G1 humanoid is priced below $16,000, and the company markets an entry-level humanoid at $13,500, setting a price benchmark that pressures Western competitors to differentiate on software and vertical integration.

The shutdown of K-Scale Labs — a Palo Alto startup that aimed to build an open-source humanoid under $10,000 — illustrates the capital challenge facing Western competitors: the founder cited brushless DC motors being 2–3x cheaper in China as the decisive cost disadvantage.

# Atlas®

Atlas isn't just built for our world. It's built to transform it, revolutionizing industrial workspaces with unmatched strength and intelligent autonomy.

[Start the Conversation](https://bostondynamics.com/atlas-contact)

WEBINAR: Form & Function of Enterprise Humanoid Design

[Watch Now](https://bostondynamics.com/webinars/form-function-enterprise-humanoid-design/)

## Meet the new industrial revolution

The world's most dynamic humanoid robot, Atlas is transforming enterprise applications. Built on decades of research and real-world experience, Boston Dynamics is delivering the new face of industrial automation.

Stop restructuring your workspace for your robots and start enabling flexible, predictable, and smart material handling with Atlas.

Deploy Seamlessly

Atlas requires minimal supervision for a range of material handling applications and supports barcode scanning and other workflow integrations.

Work Intelligently

Built with the latest advancements in AI, when one Atlas learns a new skill, that task can easily be deployed across your entire Atlas fleet.

Operate Continuously

Atlas autonomously navigates to a charging station and swaps out its own battery before getting right back on task.

Orbit is your single source of truth: your tool to connect Atlas to MES, WMS, and other systems of record; to oversee Atlas' work and performance; and to review fleet metrics.

Today, customers are supercharging their AI and enterprise data strategy with Orbit, and will be able to integrate Atlas into their existing Orbit platform.

## We're engineering a better robot

Every centimeter of Atlas is meticulously designed, manufactured, and calibrated as the world's first enterprise-grade, industrial humanoid robot. [See more specifications](https://bostondynamics.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/atlas-spec-sheet.pdf).

![Image 38: High-Power-Icon-v2](https://bostondynamics.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/High-Power-Icon-v2.svg)

###### High Power

Atlas is here to start working and stay working, with the strength and endurance to complete demanding tasks, and self-swappable batteries for continuous operation.

**Battery Life** 4 hours

**Weight Capacity (Instant)**50 kg (110 lbs) 

**Weight Capacity (Sustained)**30 kg (66 lbs) 

![Image 39: Dynamic-Icon-v2](https://bostondynamics.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Dynamic-Icon-v2.svg)

###### Dynamic

Atlas learns new tasks quickly, adapts to dynamic environments, and works autonomously with minimal supervision.

**DoF**56

**Reach**2.3 m (7.5 ft)

**Range of Motion**Continuous

![Image 40: Lightweight-Icon](https://bostondynamics.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Lightweight-Icon.svg)

###### Human-Scale

Atlas is made to operate within the same workstations using the same equipment your staff does, with robust perception, intelligent safety systems, and workflow integrations.

**Height**1.9 m (6.2 ft)

**Weight**90 kg (198 lbs)

**Sensing**Tactile and 360° camera view

![Image 41: Autonomous-Icon-v2](https://dev-boston-dynamic.pantheonsite.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Autonomous-Icon-v2.svg)

###### Robust

Atlas is designed for reliability and serviceability, with a wide operating range for predictable performance even under the toughest conditions.

**IP Rating**IP67

**Operating Temp**-20° to 40°C (-4° to 104°F)

![Image 6](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/e6d8ae79cb31981a2793a2878fe96ada.png)

## 量产版Altas

据悉，这次demo里的新版Altas是年初在CES上展示的量产版本的第一次公开亮相。

![Image 7](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/e3e5f019313491239e43b0591a548c70.png)

定位上，这代Atlas主打企业级应用，能够执行从物料搬运到订单履行等多种工业任务。

在此前放出的视频demo中，Atlas已经在汽车工厂里跑起了搬运流程，而且执行速度相当不错。

根据官方博客，这代量产版的核心设计思想是「功能大于形式」。

与不少竞争对手拼命让机器人看起来像人不同，波士顿动力反而在往「超人类」方向走，头部、腰部、髋关节都能360°旋转，做出人类做不到的姿势。

正如开头的demo里，Atlas可以用极其反人类直觉的方式转动手臂、肩膀和头部。

![Image 8](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/a7b175447081806a38ac9fce5ade6502.png)

早在CES曝光时，不少人的第一反应是「有点渗人」，但这恰恰是设计目的。

在具体的硬件细节方面，根据博主the humannoid hub的推文，Atlas全身只用了两种规格的执行器，左右臂完全相同，左右腿也完全相同。

![Image 9](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/d9dd4679b5447bf65b78dc2f3a3a15c9.png)

零件种类大幅减少，既方便规模化生产，也方便现场维修，坏了直接换一整条胳膊就行。而且每个模块可以独立迭代，不需要动其他部分的设计。

Atlas是四指抓手，三根手指加一根对拇指，指尖和手掌都有触觉传感。

这个配置是在三指和五指之间做了取舍，波士顿动力认为四指是工业场景下可靠性和灵活性的最优解。

散热方案也值得说一下。整台机器人只有一个风扇，装在头部，给计算模块降温。

![Image 10](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/35d1bee8046fa8b3a5957315214b66a1.png)

所有执行器全部靠被动散热，散热鳍片直接做进了机器人的外壳里，外壳本身就是散热器，通过增大跟空气接触的导热面积来散热。

这让Atlas运行时非常安静，也少了一个常见故障源。

机器人身上有三个指示灯，前两个是两组电池的电量指示，第三个是硬盘存储指示。

![Image 11](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/60a68583f79a135d74886b9502cc4c9b.png)

电池装在腹部外侧，Atlas可以自己走到充电站把电池换掉，不需要人帮忙，实现连续运转，充一次电跑4个小时，持续负载30公斤。定位很明确，就是工厂里的干活机器。

![Image 12](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/5524ef42190a15a8874a4273f119102f.png)

量产方面，Atlas在波士顿总部已经开始生产，2026年的产能全部分配给了现代汽车的RMAC(机器人制造应用中心)和Google DeepMind。

2027年开始向更多客户开放。现代计划建一座新的机器人工厂，目标年产能3万台。

不过，现在Altas的产能非常有限，只有每个月四台。

## 上市前夕高管洗牌

虽然demo确实炸了一波，但上市前夕的波士顿动力并不太平。

Semafor上周爆了一篇独家，题目是「C-suite exodus」，翻译过来就是高管集体出走。

2月10日，CEO Robert Playter宣布退休。这个人在波士顿动力干了32年，1994年加入，当时公司刚从MIT分出来两年，他算半个创始团队成员。

他走之后，COO和CSO跟着离开。Semafor引述前员工的说法，这两人是被董事会推走的。

CTO Aaron Saunders去了Google DeepMind。CFO Amanda McMaster暂代CEO。

这一连串离职的背景是，现代汽车对波士顿动力的耐心正在快速消耗。

现代2021年花11亿美元收购了波士顿动力多数股权，去年又承诺向美国投260亿美元，其中明确包括「数万台机器人」的订单。CES上的话术是年产3万台，但实际产量是4台/月。

按这个速度，凑够1万台需要200多年。

董事会担心的是竞争对手。Tesla的Optimus在追，Figure在追，Agility的Digit已经先一步进了工厂。

不少网友在波士顿动力的评论区下面直接开喷：你们到底是怎么失去领先优势的？

![Image 13](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/74c154f64e9e7e6fedec112a2f07f382.png)

波士顿动力是这个赛道里资历最老的玩家，但资历最老对一个被催着量产的子公司来说，不是护身符。

![Image 14](https://i.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/a9e05a8c499e4a9b0fb2604cf06cdc10.png)

公司给Semafor的官方说法是，这些变化是为了波士顿动力的下一章做准备，他们需要一个能支撑大规模制造、快速形成产业规模的组织结构。

波士顿动力，还能进入群聊吗？

## 公司介绍

优必选科技成立于2012年3月，是人形机器人的领导者和智能服务机器人的领航企业。秉承着“让智能机器人走进千家万户，让人类的生活方式变得更加便捷化、智能化、人性化”的使命，优必选布局了人形机器人全栈式技术，并在此基础上开展具身智能机器人产品及解决方案的研发、设计、智能生产和商业化应用，涵盖了多个行业的企业级和消费级广泛应用场景。2023年12月29日，优必选（股票代码：9880.HK）于香港交易所主板挂牌上市，成为“人形机器人第一股”。

优必选是全球极少数具备人形机器人全栈式技术能力的公司。我们研发了最强具身大脑：开源自研具身智能大模型Thinker，斩获九项全球第一，打造物理AI基座；研发闭环反馈的视觉语言动作模型Thinker-VLA；自研面向工业具身智能人形机器人的世界模型Thinker-WM；升级群脑网络2.0及工业具身智能人形机器人协作智能体Co–Agent，打造工业版龙虾，让机器人之间形成团队默契。在仿人小脑领域，我们融合全身遥操作、模仿学习、强化学习和经典控制技术，让机器人运动更敏捷。在本体领域，我们自研类人眼双目立体视觉感知，精度超过RGBD相机，精确率达99.5%；自研高性能伺服驱动器，拥有谐波旋转、行星旋转、行星直线三种关节技术；自研仿人五指灵巧手，实现亚毫米级精细操作；首创热插拔自主换电系统，实现3分钟自主换电，让机器人具备7*24小时连续作业能力，永不停机的新质生产力。此外，我们还自研了机器人操作系统应用框架ROSA 2.0和一站式机器人管理云平台，为人形机器人大小脑软件算法提供全链路平台支撑。

截至2025年12月底，优必选拥有2985项授权专利，其中发明专利1742项，海外授权专利508项，人形机器人有效专利数量全球第一。优必选还积极推动人形机器人行业的标准化和规范化发展，累计起草发布53项智能机器人、人工智能领域标准，并牵头制定了六项国家标准：作业操作、定位导航、人机交互、工业用人形机器人技术规范、人形机器人安全要求（工业领域）和人形机器人数据训练场建设规范。

聚焦工业制造、商用服务、家庭陪伴三大场景，优必选率先实现了人形机器人落地应用。根据同行业公司已公开披露的财务报表显示，2025年优必选全尺寸具身智能人形机器人（非遥控非玩具，身高160cm以上）收入8.2亿元，销量1079台，位列全球第一，超过80%应用于汽车制造、智慧物流、3C电子制造、半导体制造、航空制造、工业数据采集等工业场景，覆盖了多家世界500强企业客户；非全尺寸非具身智能人形机器人（含遥控、预编程，身高160cm以下）销量12759台，同比增长62.2%，也位列全球第一。

我们坚信未来是人机共存的社会，优必选以具身智能机器人为载体，人工智能技术为核心，深耕人工智能教育、智慧物流、智慧康养、商业服务、家庭消费等多个行业，打造“硬件+软件+服务+运营”的具身智能机器人产品及解决方案，致力于以创新科技服务于解决社会重大问题和满足社会重大需求，创造真正可持续发展的长期社会价值。

## 优必选五大人形机器人亮相世界机器人大会，群体智能重塑新质生产力

2025-08-08 16:08:01 来源：[量子位](https://www.qbitai.com/)

现场首发Walker S2和Cruzr S2

8 月 8 日，2025世界机器人大会（WRC 2025）在北京开幕，“人形机器人第一股”优必选携五大人形机器人亮相，包括全球首个可自主换电人形机器人Walker S2、全尺寸通用轮式人形机器人Cruzr S2、“入职”全球最多工厂的工业人形机器人Walker S1、大阪世博会中国馆首个具身智能“导览大使”Walker C、全尺寸科研级人形机器人天工行者，并通过工业制造、商用服务、科研教育、娱乐陪伴等丰富的应用场景演示，让观众沉浸式体验具身智能的使用场景，成为展会焦点。

**五大人形机器人重磅登场，Walker S2和Cruzr S2现场首发**

今年7月，优必选发布全新一代工业人形机器人Walker S2。这款机器人身高1.76米，拥有52个自由度和工业级灵巧手。通过群脑网络2.0+智能体技术Co-Agent构建AI双循环，Walker S2拥有更智慧的大脑，并具备国内首个端到端“类人眼”双目立体视觉感知。它采用拟人化设计，可在0-1.8米全空间范围内稳定搬运15公斤负载，并完成灵活摸地、极限下蹲、远距离抓取等高难度动作，其腰部更可实现±162°灵活旋转。通过刚柔异构材料的复合应用，Walker S2实现了高强度轻量化的工业级本体设计，能够以2m/s的速度进行高速拟人行走。

Walker S2还在现场展示了热插拔自主换电技术，作为全球首款具备自主换电能力的人形机器人，Walker S2首创的双电池动力平衡技术确保换电过程中的持续供电，标准化电池仓快换技术实现快速对接定位，以及高精度的双臂协同换电技术保障操作可靠性。这一革命性的能源管理系统使Walker S2仅需3分钟即可完成自主换电，配合7×24小时不间断作业能力，开创了人形机器人能源管理的新标准，为工业级连续作业提供了关键解决方案。

优必选还在大会现场展示了自研第五代灵巧手，拥有业界领先的19个主动自由度，赋予其媲美人类的丰富手势与精细操作能力；通过创新集成阵列触觉传感器与双目视觉系统，提供精准的多模态感知信息。整手重量小于1.2kg，实现超强负载性能，拇指指尖负载达到20N，抓握负载达10kg。

大会期间，优必选正式发布全尺寸通用轮式人形机器人Cruzr S2，通过搭载优必选自研人形机器人协作智能体Co-Agent，Cruzr S2融合视觉激光融合导航、学习型运动控制等具身智能关键技术, 实现复杂场景高效稳定穿行，支持全空间范围搬运与亚毫米级精度操作，满足分拣搬运、生产装配、药品转运及迎宾导览等多场景多任务作业需求，能有效助力企业提升运营效益，实现产业高质量发展。

此外，入职”全球最多工厂的工业人形机器人Walker S1、大阪世博会中国馆首个具身智能“导览大使”Walker C和全尺寸科研级人形机器人天工行者也首次在WRC 2025展出。

**“打工天团”展现硬核实力，群体智能重塑新质生产力**

本届大会，优必选首次带来突破性的人形机器人群体智能技术，以产线级任务驱动的跨场域融合感知技术、智能混合决策技术、多机协同控制等技术为基础，展示面向多任务工业场景的通用人形机器人群体作业解决方案，锻造“永不停机的新质生产力”。

通过群脑网络2.0的整体调度与任务分配管理，多台Walker S2、Cruzr S2，与UQI优奇顶升移动机器人Wali瓦力U600、无人物流车Chitu赤兔协同展示，成功展现了从物料入库搬运到智能分拣的全流程作业。通过应用工业人形机器人协作智能体Co-Agent，将Walker S2、Cruzr S2转化为具有特定职能的”智能体”（如搬运智能体、分拣智能体等不同角色）。这种群脑网络2.0+Co-Agent构成的AI双循环体系，既保证了单机的自主决策能力，又实现了群体协同的智能涌现，有效提升了整体作业效率。

在分拣、搬运工作中，Walker S2呈现了多项突破性技术：结合全身动态平衡算法、腰部两个自由度和仿生手臂设计，实现了大角度转腰分拣和极限下蹲搬运等复杂动作。

同时，现场还有11台工业人形机器人Walker S1，通过精确视觉识别和在线轨迹规划算法，完成复杂的动态随机分拣任务，其灵巧手和仿生手臂的协同操作展现了卓越的作业能力。这些机器人凭借毫秒级同步的集群控制系统，完成了整齐划一的互动展示。

在商用服务场景展示区，能跑能说的 Walker C与观众热情互动，展示了多语言交互、导览接待、客串主持等功能。针对科研教育领域，优必选联合北京人形机器人创新中心于今年3月共同推出的天工行者在大会上吸引了众多科研人员的驻足了解，让人形机器人科研创新成为青年追求的梦想。围绕娱乐陪伴场景，优必选在WRC 2025上带来了自主研发的具备数字生命内核的家庭智能机器人AI悟空，这也是AI悟空在国内的首次亮相。全新升级发布的AI潮玩陪伴机器人萌UU这次也来到大会现场，凭借独特的魅力征服全场。

正如WRC 2025的主题”让机器人更智慧，让具身体更智能”，人形机器人产业正从技术突破迈向规模化落地新阶段，从工业场景的群体智能技术突破到多场景应用加速落地，优必选以全栈式技术布局的优势，在为工业制造领域锻造 “永不停机的新质生产力”的同时，也让机器人的智慧应用到商用服务、科研教育、娱乐陪伴等多个领域，不仅帮助人类提升工作效率，更致力于守护生活的温度，引领全球人形机器人产业的高质量发展。

## 连续完成2轮融资！智元机器人分拆灵巧手公司，获高瓴、蓝驰领投入局千亿市场

[![Image 8: A 34x34 small image, likely a logo, icon or avatar](https://oss.forbeschina.com/user-1/20191029145377.jpg)作者：福布斯中国](https://www.forbeschina.com/author/13)

智元机器人旗下分拆的灵巧手子公司——临界点近日宣布，2026年1月20日同日连续完成两轮融资，由高瓴创投与蓝驰创投联合领投。这意味着，随着人形机器人产业化步入放量竞争阶段，决定其“作业能力”上限的灵巧手正从实验室样品加速迈向规模化应用，一个潜力巨大的细分市场正在开启。

此次智元机器人将其核心的灵巧手部门独立运营，成立临界点，由原业务负责人、拥有腾讯Robotics X背景的熊坤牵头。这一安排并非简单的业务剥离，而是智元在行业演进关键节点做出的重要布局。

智元机器人于2023年2月成立于上海，是通用具身机器人领域的独角兽企业，拥有远征等三大机器人家族及“智元启元大模型”，布局多形态机器人产品，自研核心部件、创新租赁模式，业务覆盖多场景。据Omdia报告，2025年该公司人形机器人出货量超5,100台，全球市占率达39%，而IDC报告显示，其全尺寸机型及五大主流场景出货量均位居全球首位。

智元机器人分拆临界点背后的商业逻辑清晰而务实。首先，灵巧手作为人形机器人复杂度最高的部件，其研发涉及机、电、算、软及材料等多学科深度协同，技术壁垒极高。将其独立运营，有利于吸引专项人才和资本，以更灵活的机制专注于技术快速迭代与前沿攻关。

事实上，2026年初智元机器人关联公司获“灵巧手手指、灵巧手和机器人”相关专利授权，临界点作为技术承接方，正着力依托核心专利解决产品小型化等工程难题；其次，独立公司身份使其能够更开放地服务全域生态，而不仅限于母公司内部需求。临界点已形成覆盖不同自由度与精度的全矩阵产品策略，并以“量产一代、研发一代、预研一代”的节奏保持领先，目标是为各类机器人厂商提供“手+数据”的闭环解决方案；最后，这也符合产业精细化分工的趋势。在人形机器人竞争焦点从“能动”转向“能干”的当下，整机厂与核心部件供应商通过专业化分工协同发展，有望共同做大产业蛋糕。

灵巧手作为人形机器人实现精细操作的核心部件，是公认价值最高的核心模块之一。据东吴证券预测，到2030年，全球人形机器人新增需求将达136万台；该机构进一步预测，到2035年，这一新增需求将攀升至1163万台。基于这一产量预期及灵巧手的高价值占比测算，仅该单一部件就将催生一个超千亿元规模的细分市场。

近期，灵巧手赛道融资活跃。灵心巧手于2025年12月完成A++轮融资，投资方包括红杉中国等机构，并计划在2026年实现数万台级的交付目标。2025年12月26日，初创公司曦诺未来（Xynova）完成超亿元天使轮融资，由宁德时代旗下资本领投，小米战投等跟投。

临界点背靠智元已实现先发优势，其产品在2025年季度销量已达数千台，应用于工业制造、物流分拣等多个场景，初步形成了“场景反馈-产品迭代”的商业闭环。随着资本加速涌入，灵巧手赛道的发展临界点或许已近在眼前。
